verdict.rationale: Cua documents some user-controlled deletion. Uninstall removes the CLI and setup but keeps Spaces and their data unless you explicitly ask for them to be removed (cua-docs-29), and users can lock or delete vault items (cua-docs-17). The Cua Volume is a versioned drive with an audit log (cua-docs-25), which bears on retention, though no controls over it are described. missing for 10: configurable retention periods or policies, documented deletion of account/Volume/cloud-relay data, deletion of agent memory or session data, independent corroboration.
